subject: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP — dependency and risk prioritization
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP — dependency and risk prioritization

Team,

We have the FedRAMP readiness call scheduled with ClearShield (they're the intake partner) on 2026-11-20. Before that I want a compact dependency and risk list we can hand to the auditors so we aren't chasing items during the call.

Ask:
- Owners: each of you confirm the evidence owner for your domains (identity, logging, config mgmt, SRE runbooks) by EOD 2026-11-04.
- Dependencies: call out any third-party evidence (cloud audit logs, vendor SOC2) and whether we can pull samples by 2026-11-12.
- Risk/Impact: flag anything that could block the readiness review (retention <90 days, missing MFA enforcement, non‑covered regions).

I've attached a draft evidence matrix — use it to populate owners.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-matrix-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@clearshield.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP — dependency and risk prioritization

Marcus,

Thanks — I've started the matrix and added initial owners. Quick notes:
- Logging: we have 180 days for app logs but only 30 days for infra metrics in the current retention policy. Owner: Mina Haddad.
- Identity: Okta config export available; will attach mapping. Owner: Neha.
- Vendor SOC2: two vendors (CloudNet, DataStore inc.) — CloudNet has a current SOC2; DataStore's report expires 2026-12-01.

Open items I need help with:
1) Confirmation that we can provide sampled syslog exports for the region eu-west-1 (audit wants cross-region samples).
2) Doc owner for the incident response table — suggest Jonas.

Attached my control mapping PDF with comments.

- Mina

[Attachment: control-mapping.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@clearshield.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP — dependency and risk prioritization

Marcus / team,

Thanks for the heads up and the attachment. A few items we need ahead of the intake call:
- Retention matrix: please confirm retention policy per log type and provide a sample export (syslog + access logs) for one producer for the period 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31.
- Evidence types: for FedRAMP we'll need config snapshots, control owners, and proof of enforcement for MFA across admin roles.
- Timing: intake forms due by 2026-11-12 to give auditors a week to triage before the 11/20 review.

Can you also provide:
- SOC2 latest report (if available) or proof of SOC2 readiness.
- Point of contact for DocuSign/SEA forms.

I've attached our standard audit intake form; fill the top section and return.

Best,
Sarah Clark
Senior Compliance Consultant
ClearShield Compliance
[Attachment: audit-intake-form.docx (document)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@clearshield.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP — dependency and risk prioritization

Sarah / team,

Appreciate the clarity. Quick update and commitments:
- Retention: we will provide a sample syslog + access log export for app-prod-01 covering 2026-10-01—2026-10-31 by 2026-11-12. Owner: Mina.
- MFA proof: Neha will provide admin role snapshots and enforcement logs (owner: Neha). Target: 2026-11-10.
- SOC2: we don't have a final report yet — our external auditor completes fieldwork 2026-11-25. We'll include a readiness statement and the latest internal gap assessment by 11/12.
- Incident response owner: Jonas confirmed and will upload the IR table to the shared drive.

Priority risk buckets (high/medium/low):
- High: infra metrics retention (30d) vs expected >90d — remediation backlog ticket SEC-6423. (Owner: Mina) — mitigation: extend retention to 90d in eu-west-1 by 2026-11-18.
- Medium: DataStore SOC2 lapse — procurement to chase supplier evidence. (Owner: Neha)
- Low: Documentation gaps for config snapshot cadence — will be closed in doc sprint week of 11/15. (Owner: Jonas)

Please confirm you have enough to start triage. If clear, we'll circulate a filled intake form and the evidence folder link.

Action items: please confirm your assigned items by EOD 2026-11-08.

Marcus Lin
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Links:
- Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxxx-evidence-matrix
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-6423
Attachments: none in this message.
